items.title: Teledyne Technologies (TDY) Lands Defense Orders And Expands Its Role In Military Sensors
items.summary: Teledyne Technologies (NYSE: TDY) reported major contract milestones, including a substantial order for thermal weapon sights from the German Bundeswehr. The company entered a partnership with Everspin Technologies to bring advanced memory solutions to aerospace and defense customers. Teledyne was selected for a key role in the U.S. Army's next generation uncooled infrared program. items.title: Everspin and Teledyne HiRel Partner to Offer MRAM for Aerospace and Defense Applications
items.summary: Everspin Technologies (NASDAQ:MRAM) and Teledyne HiRel Semiconductors, a unit of Teledyne Technologies (NYSE:TDY), announced a partnership to make Everspin’s PERSYST spin-transfer torque MRAM available through Teledyne HiRel’s memory product portfolio for aerospace and defense customers. The collaboration will initially focus on Everspin’s 256Mb PERSYST STT-MRAM and will also cover the company’s 64Mb and 128Mb PERSYST products.
